prompt: One day shows 1,000,000 visits because someone typed an extra zero.
why: A single point far from the rest is an outlier.
trap: Not a swing period; one wrong point.

prompt: Sales at the café spiked on the one day a concert was next door.
tells: on the one day a concert was next door
why: A one-off event makes an outlier.

prompt: One huge order made the monthly average look much higher than normal.
trap: It's a single point, not a trend.

prompt: Before using the data, the analyst looks for points far from the rest.
trap: It isn't noise; it's extreme points.

prompt: Traffic dropped to zero for one hour during a server outage.
tells: for one hour during a server outage
why: A one-off drop is an outlier.

prompt: They use the middle value instead of the average so one spike doesn't skew it.
tells: so one spike doesn't skew it
trap: It isn't smoothing; it's ignoring extremes.
